## Services Offered

### Apartment Building Sales
Complete investment sales advisory for purpose-built rental apartments across Ontario. From 10-unit walk-ups to 1,000+ suite institutional portfolios.

### Seniors Housing Sales  
Specialized advisory for retirement residences, long-term care facilities, assisted living properties, and memory care facilities.

### Student Housing Sales
Investment sales for purpose-built student accommodations, university residences, and student-oriented rental properties.

### Portfolio Advisory
Multi-property portfolio transactions, strategic dispositions, and portfolio optimization consulting.

### CMHC Financing Guidance
Expert guidance on CMHC insured mortgage products including MLI Select enhanced terms for qualifying properties.

### Property Valuations
Complimentary confidential opinions of value for apartment building owners across Ontario.
